v0.5.0.description:
- Fix: About urls incorrect for localhost:8080 The port was being included twice due to use of window.location.host instead of window.location.hostname
- Start to multiple chatrooms. It doesn't quite work yet.
- It works now. Fixed issues with chatroom selection/joining (text input issue)
- prep v0.5.0
- Styling: Fix layout so things are better placed (following feedback)
- Fix reproducible build (hopefully). There were 2 issues at play: - CRLF/LF line ending difference on windows/linux - ChatMessage.module.css seemed to cause different minified names on Windows/Linux
- More styling improvements for mobile users.
- Refactor: Getting copilot to break stuff down. App was getting too monolithic so it's time to break it into smaller components/chunks. Should make it easier for me to manage.
- Make swipe gestures actually work on mobile!
- Merge branch 'multiple-chatrooms'

v0.4.1.description:
- Add browser IDBBlockstore support.
- Add build-time script to manage history.
- Remove references to old text bit.
- Add ChatMessage+ChatInput+ChatRoom components.
- Fix: Libp2p options When refactoring the libp2p options, it was not using helia sane defaults. We weren't getting many peers any more.
- Make ChatInput component support multiline text.

v0.4.0-a2.description: Improved peers UI, added click-to-copy text. A few nice-to-haves.

v0.4.0-a1.description: Added IndexDB datastore for libp2p and helia persistence.

v0.3.0.description: Added settings page, added WebTransport+WebRTC-Direct, tidied up app.

0.2.1.description: Changed BrowserRouter to HashRouter to allow for routing on IPFS web-gateways, since /about/index.html doesn't actually exist.

0.2.0.description: Added react routing with an about page (this page) with historical version information.

0.1.0.description: Initial release with basic chat functionality.
